evidence: Independent read-only security review of the revised frozen candidate. Verified all 27 candidate-listed untracked file hashes match; the candidate keeps the same tracked diff digest as its predecessor, with the revised replay implementation and tests bound by updated hashes. The slice remains an in-process market normalizer/replay utility: no HTTP replay route, socket, broker/model client, credential consumption, persistence writer, or live order path was added. Fixture data is synthetic and contains no credentials. Existing startup/config handling redacts provider credentials and database details; service responses expose only credential presence; PAPER mode remains literal and guarded; local Compose DB remains loopback-bound and ephemeral. The revision improves replay validation by rejecting duplicate trade and duplicate quote identities both within a parsed batch and across replay steps, with cursor unchanged on rejection. One non-blocking edge remains: freshness is based on receive age, so a future receive timestamp can be fresh until the clock catches up; replay is currently local/in-process and unexposed. No concrete security blocker found.
